trap-nonspeakable.notes: THREE FLAGS for the report. (1) FALSE INCLUSION: 'The full sum is therefore an element of Habiro-hat(Z[q]) SUBSET Q(q)'. The Habiro ring is a completion of Z[q] with respect to the ideals ((q;q)_n); it is strictly larger than and not contained in Q(q) - that non-containment is the point of the construction. The inclusion is stated backwards. (2) The proof's final step invokes 'the volume conjecture' while the block it proves, prop:topological-mass-formula-algebraic, claims in its own text to bypass 'hyperbolic volume conjectures'. (3) That same proposition writes the quantity as ln|Vol_{q_0}(beta)| while this proof identifies it with Vol(K)/hbar_{q_0}^2 - a logarithm in one and not the other.
